overview_description.description: Starcloud develops space-based data center infrastructure designed to support computing and data processing beyond Earth environments. The company builds and deploys satellites equipped with computing hardware to enable in-orbit data processing, storage, and artificial intelligence workloads. Its systems leverage continuous solar energy and passive cooling conditions in space to operate large-scale compute clusters. Starcloud also designs satellite architectures and supporting technologies for handling high-performance workloads, including machine learning training and inference. The organization conducts testing through launched satellites and collaborates with technology providers to integrate computing components into orbital platforms. Its offerings focus on enabling scalable computing capacity through distributed space-based infrastructure.
